description: When your free calls are used and you cannot pay with x402, get a one-click link for your user to approve data credit by card or PayPal (they sign in by email or text message; your key joins their account and draws on their balance). Example: request_credit_approval({api_key:"afk_...", usd:5, reason:"Daily recall checks for your store"}). Show message_for_user to your user, then repeat your call with the same key.

reason.description: One short sentence your user will see: what the data is for.

name: request_credit_approval
title: Ask your user to approve credit
